Reply with the JSON object only.

selected.why: Model 1 has the rectangular massing with a colonnade of columns on the front-right end and a rooftop-free flat roof, matching the Asian Art Museum's columned Beaux-Arts facade and block-like form, whereas Model 2 lacks the columned portico and Model 3 is a U/L-shaped courtyard building that does not match the museum's solid rectangular block.
